create_CTCHead: create a CTCHead module with specified in_channels and out_channels for CTC recognition
build_CTCHead_two_layer: build a CTCHead with mid_channels to create a two-layer fully connected head
run_CTCHead_forward: run the CTCHead forward pass on input tensor to produce CTC predictions
test_CTCHead_return_feats: test the CTCHead forward pass with return_feats=True to get both predictions and intermediate features
review_CTCHead_class: review the CTCHead class that wraps nn.Linear layers for CTC output prediction
